A 10/10 album is a rare sight indeed, and I have only found a few that I find myself coming back to time after time because they're just so friggin good. Without further ado, here are my personal 10/10 power metal albums:

  1. Nightwish - Century Child
  2. Blind Guardian - A Night at the Opera
  3. Iced Earth - Horror Show
  4. Twilightning - Delirium Veil
  5. Avantasia - The Metal Opera pt. II

Honorable mentions: Lost Horizon, Masterplan - Masterplan, Pyramaze - Legend of the Bone Carver, Gloryhammer - TKOF

What are your 10/10s?

Oh boy, this was a lot harder that I thought. Not because I don't have any 10/10 albums, but because I have too many. I realized that the requirements are probably not strong enough. Therefore, my requirements for a 10/10 album are thus:

  • I have to like every single song on the album, no exceptions
  • I have to AT LEAST know how the chorus goes in every single song, no exceptions
  • Only one album per band

It's interesting because, for example, The Metal Opera Pt. 2 is undeniably one of my favorite albums, but it doesn't make the list because there are a couple (literally 2) songs that I don't remember how the chorus goes. Anyway, here is the result (in alphabetical order)

  • Edguy - Tinnitus Sanctus (this is legitimately embarrassing)
  • Hammerfall - No Sacrifice, No Victory
  • Helloween - Gambling With the Devil
  • Iron Mask - Shadow of the Red Baron
  • Powerwolf - Bible of the Beast
  • Sabaton - Coat of Arms
  • Symfonia - In Paradisum

Definitely not what I would have picked in terms of just "best albums off the top of my head." But there you go. In terms of "albums which have strictly good songs that I like AND have listened to enough to know how they go," that's it. Pretty fun exercise.

Edguy - Tinnitus Sanctus (this is legitimately embarrassing)

No need to be embarrassed. I love Tinnitus Sanctus.

I think your requirements for a 10/10 are a good way to narrow it down. Unfortunately for me, on nearly every album I love there are one or two songs that I don't really like. I bet I couldn't find more than 3 (if that) albums which meet that criteria. It's better to have too few than too many though, I guess.

I don't know what I think of Edguy. I prefer their earlier work, but still Tinnitus is my second favorite album (after Vain Glory Opera). Haven't given Space Police a go yet now that I think about it...

Blind Guardian - Imaginations from the Other Side: only just beats Nightfall in Middle-Earth by a narrow margin.

Keldian - Heaven's Gate: there's just something special about this album that I can't describe. Plus it has catchy-as-hell choruses.

Power Quest - Wings of Forever: most people don't like this as much as PQ's other albums but I love every minute of it.
